name: done-gate
description: Notices when Claude marks a task done while code it changed has not been tested since, and tells Claude and you; a band shows the last test run. It warns, it never blocks

testCommands.title: Your test commands
testCommands.description: Comma-separated commands that run your tests, added to the usual runners (pytest, npm test, go test, cargo test and others). Example: ./scripts/check.sh, make ci

ignore.title: Not code
ignore.description: Comma-separated file endings whose changes need no test run.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: off: the band stays hidden until you type /done-gate on, and /done-gate off hides it again. on: the band shows from the start. Either way the mod keeps working; this changes only what is drawn.
